{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Wait a Minute''''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]] and the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]]. The ''Wait a Minute'' was captained by [[Jav Patrell]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the ''Wait a Minute'' participated in the [[Battle of Mindor]], where it was destroyed when waves of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] on a suicide run rammed the ''Wait a Minute's'' hull.<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />
